verdict.rationale: The BYOK docs say AI Gateway can authenticate requests with your own provider credentials at no markup, and the `byok` option in `providerOptions.gateway` lets you pass different credentials per request. Two caveats temper this: the docs say failed queries are retried with Vercel's system credentials, so not all traffic is guaranteed to use your keys, and a community report says BYOK requests appear to be blocked when the Vercel account balance hits $0. missing for 10: documentation of team/project-level key configuration, a way to force BYOK-only traffic with no fallback to system credentials, independent hands-on confirmation, and clarity on whether BYOK depends on account balance.
